name: Pulsaria
description: Motor local-first de escritorio para procesar contenido audiovisual autorizado de TikTok, generar transcripciones y análisis, e indexar una biblioteca para búsqueda literal y semántica.

domains.name: ingestion
domains.description: Tauri IPC commands for authorized TikTok URL ingestion, job creation and collection expansion

domains.name: processing
domains.description: Worker pool management, retry logic, circuit breaker, pipeline execution

domains.name: persistent_sources
domains.description: Registration, canonical SQLite persistence, TikTok profile synchronization and source activity; scanning is delegated to the canonical Python worker

domains.name: editorial
domains.description: Single-source and multi-source editorial compilation with evidence provenance, contract validation and persistence through the magazine service

domains.name: transcription
domains.description: Python worker spawning, stdout event parsing, progress tracking

domains.name: indexing
domains.description: Semantic search orchestrator: embedding, chunking, vector index, reranker, cache

domains.name: library
domains.description: SQLite schema, migrations, raw queries for jobs, media, transcripts, playlists

entrypoints.frontend: app/page.tsx (única fuente activa; ZIP solo de referencia)

ports.frontendPolicy: single canonical app/components/hooks/lib/types tree; isolated opt-in DemoMediaProvider only; no demo content in library runtime

canonicalPolicy.persistentSourceProjection: lib/profile-source.ts -> collection_sources records; UI mapping only, no second persisted profile store
canonicalPolicy.editorialPersistence: magazine_* tables in src-tauri/src/db.rs, with source and evidence provenance linked to canonical jobs
canonicalPolicy.editorialCompilationQueue: magazine_compilations; separate lifecycle from ingestion QueueService
canonicalPolicy.manualProfileFlow: Task 01 uses register_profile_source and update_profile_source_settings; later discovery delegates to connect_tiktok_source; no parallel profile downloader
